acceptance: Produce one self-contained validation spec with publishable scope, acceptance criteria and complete criterion-to-selected-test mappings.
Stamp specs with the selected engine, actual model, reviewer-file digest, host, UTC time, fetched remote baseline and request/proposal digests; refuse stale remote ancestry.
Use the canonical family seal formula, reject non-finite values and detect modification of any sealed field.
Refuse secret-like text and local absolute paths in published spec content, retaining private request and proposal bodies only through digests.
Select explicit or automatic reviewer engines deterministically, reject unknown engines and preserve the prohibition on automatic fallback.
Invoke the Claude reviewer with restricted read-only tools, disabled MCP access and schema-bound output; reject error envelopes, malformed output and missing model identity.
Deliver required external authorities and supplied external evidence as exact hash-bound inputs, rejecting missing, inaccessible or changed inputs before dispatch.
Migrate existing contracts only through native revisions naming the original contract hash, preserve historical evidence and require matching approved native proposal evidence for local admission.

Admit genuine documentation-only ranges without a spec and reject executable ranges with missing, stale, malformed or tampered specs; require every changed path across the complete publication baseline-to-candidate range to fall within the selected scope, including changes preceding the spec baseline.
Make both deterministic lanes and CI execute every selected category completely while preserving fixed lane checks, historical-selection restrictions and original delivery clocks.
Preserve existing validation-contract and feature-design binding requirements.
Admit the intended maintainer instruction entrypoints and skill mirror through publication checks while continuing to reject private and look-alike paths.
Execute a configured virtualenv interpreter for Vault indexing using its configured executable path, preserving the virtualenv rather than resolving the executable to its base interpreter.

Compare proposal source observations using equivalent effective-source snapshots, retain concurrent implementation changes as unadopted observations and reject changes to bound proposal evidence or governing criteria.

Preserve controller lifecycle and reused-process rejection through process-birth checks; isolate explicit Codex launcher tests from inherited harness engine selection without changing automatic engine selection.
Preserve independent parallel-review custody, overlap and failure handling while binding the configured reviewer effort after the maximum-effort cap.
Run the complete scope-index suite through its Node entrypoint with the copied CLI dependency closure, preserving trailer provenance and execution-suffix checks.

Prepare the patch release consistently across canonical manifests, lockfile, release documentation, skill release metadata and generated client manifests while preserving product composition, transport and authentication declarations.
Exercise scoped controller admission, complete launcher fixtures and bounded reviewer settings without weakening custody assertions; classify declared governing-authority drift as an execution error.
Preserve direct-human public API version request evidence checks through proposal, receipt and commit verification.

Keep review-policy fingerprints sensitive to current module content and executable modes while reusing parsed representations only for identical content; preserve performance and lifecycle assertions.
For changes outside both deterministic lanes, run selected spec tests and native exact-candidate command coverage before CI reports success; fail immediately on spec-gate failure.
Preserve source-frontier delivery and forged-page rejection, and retain closed live-verifier arguments and deterministic release integration.

Publish a complete private mutation-lock owner record atomically before contenders can observe its path; retain exclusive acquisition, live-owner renewal, token-scoped abandoned-owner recovery and owner-matched release, with staging cleanup after successful publication and contention.
Retain an unchanged barrier-controlled regression that fails on the former incomplete lock publication and passes with atomic publication, without retries or timing-based outcome selection.
Exercise overlapping notification writers on one partition with explicit barriers while the first holds the lock, preserving both pending identities and later generations through acknowledgements.

Synchronize the lifecycle failure observer on accepted attachment before owner failure; propagate that failure to the attached observer while preserving the prior admitted checkpoint, using timeouts only as hang guards.

Accept exact historical deterministic-lane provenance only with the applicable lane profile, admitted publication range, complete required commands and selected categories, retained complete outputs and native result bindings; reject missing, tampered, fabricated, incomplete, CI-phase, failed or superseded evidence while preserving native Oracle provenance.

Exercise published-product export through a local published-ref fixture with lane-produced synthetic provenance, preserving exact commit checks and package parity without requiring live GitHub access.

Complete release preparation, verification and promotion without invoking the GitHub CLI; use the configured owned SSH push destination for Git effects and unauthenticated public REST for remaining reads, rejecting foreign or ambiguous destinations.

Publish one canonical attestation containing the exact repository, candidate commit and tree, technical receipt digest and complete approval, command-coverage and environment rows only after native evidence verification; readers reject incorrect parents, files, canonical bytes, bindings and duplicate or malformed contexts.

Reuse unchanged attestation objects and preserve replacement history through the previous attestation parent, expected-old-value leases and exact remote readback; reject stale leases and unconfirmed effects.

Use attestation rows consistently in CI and fresh-clone commit verification; only genuine ref absence permits legacy public-status fallback with the pinned creator, while malformed, conflicting, revoked or unreadable current attestations fail closed.

Require exact remote release and baseline heads plus the latest successful repository-owned publication-safety push run and verification job for the exact candidate and release ref; reject failed, missing, mismatched or incomplete evidence regardless of branch protection.

Promote through ancestry-checked, exact-baseline leased fast-forward pushes with destination revalidation and exact main readback across native and deterministic paths; preserve immutable receipts, later-decision revocation, scoped human authority and concurrent authoring.

After observing an owner no longer alive, re-read its custody-checked completed result before orphan recovery and return an admitted result without duplicate review dispatch; preserve genuine orphan recovery and failure propagation. Retain an unchanged deterministic fail-before/pass-after regression that drives incomplete-result, dead-owner and completed-result reads without timers, and preserve the existing attached-caller checkpoint-admission regression.

acceptance_tests.purpose: Verify sealed spec production, privacy, engine invocation, external input custody, native migration, publication-range scope, configured interpreter preservation, CI branch admission and historical deterministic-provenance refusal boundaries.
Preserve native contract recording, revision rules, selected execution and exact feature-design binding.

Verify both deterministic lanes retain scope admission, selected execution and fixed verification boundaries while replacing CLI merges with exact-source CI admission and leased fast-forward publication.
Verify permitted maintainer entrypoints and continued rejection of private or misleading publication paths.
Verify equivalent proposal snapshots, concurrent source deltas, evidence drift rejection, complete attestation-row consumption and exact-source prepared publication without the GitHub CLI.

Verify controller lifecycle, process-birth rejection, explicit launcher isolation, accepted-observer failure propagation with checkpoint preservation, and deterministic completion rechecking before orphan recovery without duplicate review dispatch.
Verify parallel review custody, capped effort, overlap and failure handling.
Execute the complete native scope-index suite with its copied dependencies and retained provenance checks.
Verify patch progression, consistent release markers and native release preparation.
Verify canonical and generated metadata, product composition and preserved transport and authentication declarations.
Verify scoped admission custody, governing-authority drift errors, complete launcher dependencies and bounded reviewer settings.
Verify proposal and receipt governance with complete fixtures and the required workflow-to-native-coverage chain.
Verify independent direct-human version-request evidence across proposal, receipt and commit verification.
Verify bounded discovery and review behavior, policy-sensitive evidence and isolated explicit launcher execution.
Execute native source-frontier delivery and forged-page refusal under the configured effort bound.
Verify closed verifier arguments, pre-execution refusal boundaries and the deterministic release verification command.
Verify complete atomic lock publication at an explicit barrier, private staging cleanup and preserved exclusive ownership, renewal, recovery and release.
Verify overlapping queue writers retain pending identities and newer generations under the shared mutation lock.
Verify local published-ref export with lane-produced provenance, exact commit checks, package parity and refusal of missing, altered, incomplete or CI-phase provenance.

Verify canonical attestation custody, idempotent reuse, chained replacement, forged and revoked record refusal, legacy issuer enforcement, exact-source remote admission and leased promotion with scoped authority.

Verify SSH-only shipment preparation and confirmed delivery, shared attestation verification, immutable checkpoint reuse, later-decision revocation and publication while independent authoring continues.

selection.reason: Revise the existing feature contract while retaining every earlier acceptance criterion, selected module and fixture. Add lifecycle source scope and a deterministic regression proving that a completed owner is rechecked before orphan recovery, while preserving checkpoint custody, genuine orphan recovery and failure propagation. Preserve all earlier publication, provenance, privacy and native verification boundaries. Run every selected category completely, with no automatic wider regression, clock reset or paid fallback; retain the original 300-second delivery clock and historical outcomes.
